_meta.description: Repo-owned synthetic evaluation corpus for the Memotron hermetic benchmark. Fictional enterprise-documentation domain: Northport Systems, an invented industrial-telemetry software company (no real organization). Authored in the LongMemEval item shape and scored with the deterministic LoCoMo category-F1 judge over the profile-top-evidence executor.
_meta.answer_granularity: Gold answers are authored at evidence-sentence granularity (the exact materialized fact text) so the deterministic executor is scored on retrieval selection, not span extraction.
_meta.temporal_design: Each temporal scenario updates a single-active state slot in a later session; the retired value carries HIGHER confidence than its replacement, and every 'current' question deliberately ties on lexical overlap between the retired and updated values, so profile order (confidence-ranked) decides the answer — only genuine supersession removes the stale row and yields the updated value. The change is also recorded as a durable decision fact: 'historical' questions target the retired value via that change record.
